correctness.rationale: For n≥3 the adjacency blocks C=11^T-I have the four distinct eigenvalues ±(n-1), ±1 with exactly known eigenspaces. A nonempty sink kills both uniform eigenspaces and forces the zero-sum modes to vanish at each represented matched-pair index. This leaves exactly two copies of the n-t dimensional coordinate zero-sum hyperplane, of dimension 2 max(n-t-1,0). Strict positivity of every local loss forces every non-dark eigenmode into the stable open left half-plane. Diagonalizing the complementary projector yields sitewise capture 1 or 1/(n-t); the dimension proves minimum n-1 sites and n2^(n-1) labelled optimal placements. Package C++ verifies 5916 exact modular Krylov ranks; separate direct spectral projector comparisons passed 1357 finite cases. Limits: n≥3, T nonempty, all rates>0, uniform J>0, no claim on finite-time speed.
